findings.summary: Biome colors (grass, foliage, water) are not rendered correctly in LODs. The biome wrapper system exists but biome colors may not be properly applied during LOD generation or rendering.
findings.root_cause: BiomeWrapper serializes biome data but the color application in FullDataToRenderDataTransformer or LodDataBuilder may not correctly retrieve biome colors from the wrapper. The getBlockColor() method may not be using the biome parameter correctly.
evidence: BiomeWrapper.java: Serializes biome but may not preserve color data
LodDataBuilder.java:153-243: Tracks biome changes but may not apply colors

primary.issue: getBlockColor() may not correctly apply biome colors

gap_analysis.current_behavior: Biome colors not applied to LODs
gap_analysis.required_behavior: Grass, foliage, water should show biome-specific colors

proposed_fix.approach: Verify biome color is being retrieved and applied during LOD data generation
implementation_steps: 3. Add debug logging for biome color application

falsification_test.description: If biome colors still don't apply after fix, issue is in color cache

confidence_reason: Code path identified but exact failure point needs verification
